value.rationale: A complete infinite-domain hom-set classification and thin-category theorem for a natural weakened algebraic semantics, directly extending the 2021 object-level study. It rules out unexpected noninjective maps despite failure of term-equivalence with MV and proper exotic subalgebras. The necessity of both join and square is demonstrated by explicit counterexamples in weaker signatures.
